A few comments re the panel discussion on @MeetThePress re: Biden. 

1. We are NOT "post-#Metoo " era. We're IN IT. 

2. No, @RichLowry. In MANY workplaces sexual harassment is NOT reported to HR. That is the problem. Don't flatten out a systemic, societal-wide crisis.

I said just now, in the same way that we weren't "post-racial" during Obama, we're aren't post-#MeToo.  We are IN THE SOUP. 
If Biden wants to play, he needs to be forthright and present.
